scope: first actual user request through map delivery; excludes subsequent retrospective analysis
source: timestamps and visible messages/tool calls of this same task session, cross-checked with workspace build/solver logs

phases.name: 资料检查、初始设计及擅自扩海方案
phases.interpretation: 存在必要资料准备，也有未经授权的海湾/低地改动，随后被撤销

phases.name: 撤销扩海、按原图重建和首轮原生验收
phases.interpretation: 原图复建有效，但没有在此阶段一次性落实全部赠送、完整矿场和最终路线联合约束

phases.name: 完整占地暴露问题后的路线/矿位/赠送联合返工
phases.interpretation: 主要耗时段；临时完善通路检查，多次移矿/转向，尝试外围矿联合求解并失败，再联合规划110组主备用赠送点

phases.name: 范围重新判定、撤回候选和编写锁定审计
phases.interpretation: 将坡面、岸坡和边界保护混在同一范围判断中；隔离整个候选并临时补写独立锁定工具，随后又按用户坡道许可恢复

phases.name: 回合之间的等待间隔
phases.interpretation: 只作经过时间，不算程序计算时间，也不将其归责为用户拖延

phases.name: 恢复制作、确认允许新增坡道及重新准备输入
phases.interpretation: 包含恢复已撤回的本轮输入、重新解码PNG、移除额外岸坡和水深塑形，以及实现层面的修错

phases.name: 最后制作与完整验收、冻结和交付
phases.interpretation: 包含计时前段、已记录的15分20秒，以及步骤交接和最后答复时间

limits: Phase durations are wall-clock elapsed time between verified checkpoints, not per-algorithm CPU profiles.
Per-step historical monotonic instrumentation did not exist before the timing request; exact process-only breakdown cannot be reconstructed.
Asynchronous subprocesses overlap agent activity; outer tool-call wait durations and compile times must not be added to phase totals.
The original first-turn start event precedes the actual user request by about 1.5 seconds; full elapsed uses the actual user request.
findings: The largest full-task stage is late final-reservation route/resource/gift rework.
Unauthorized terrain adjustments and later whole-candidate quarantine caused avoidable rework.
One-off authoring and acceptance tools were developed during the task, increasing serial iteration and compilation.
The last 15m20 timing covers only about one tenth of the entire task and does not describe the full-task bottleneck.
